Kim / Monica — quick ops summary from our side after looking at the supplied logs and live traces:

- Observed behavior: user completes SSO handshake, receives valid Redwood session cookie, then a background call to /payment/validate immediately returns 403 with code "credential_stale". The Ariba connector report shows the same request id.
- Root cause (likely): token/nonce rotation mismatch — when the IdP session was bound to a short-lived SAML nonce we recently rolled (security rotation last week), some relay-state sequences from older browser sessions can present a stale nonce to the payment endpoint's backend validation. That path triggers a 403 to protect payment details.

Action plan:
1) Hotfix (ops): extend acceptance window for payment-validation nonces for specific partner Fathom Corp while we roll a proper fix. This is low-risk (we scope to that partner and the single endpoint). I've opened SUP-1234 and added traces + the merchant log: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-1234
2) Customer steps: clear cookies and local storage, then reattempt the flow OR open an incognito window and use the direct supplier portal link (we'll DM the link to ensure it bypasses stale relay-state).
3) If the hotfix doesn't work within an hour, we will generate a pre-authorized one-time validation token for your team (manual override) so you can complete onboarding and receive POs.

I've attached the operations snippet we captured for the failing requests (fathom_bank_merchant_log.txt). Monica, can you coordinate the DM with Andrew and send the bypass link?

--
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
